user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: Search crawling for ChatGPT search features to display web results and navigational links.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads; data is not used for model training.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train OpenAI generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawling web content to make foundation models more useful and safe.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-initiated actions and browsing in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-triggered requests and GPT Actions; not used for automatic crawling or search.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated actions; robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Public web content for AI model development and training.
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: ClaudeBot Disallow: / in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content in response to user questions and requests.
user_agents.scope: Web content accessed through user-initiated queries.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes online content to improve search result quality, relevance, and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Public web content for search optimization and indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot

user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for the Google News product

user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-News

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot

user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Google-CloudVertexBot

user_agents.purpose: Controls training and grounding Gemini models in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI
user_agents.scope: Gemini model training and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet automatically or for search.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information operating in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features and provides context for AI outputs across Apple products.
user_agents.scope: Web crawl data for Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and Apple foundation model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled web data for training Apple foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Training data for generative foundation models powering Apple Intelligence and tools.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in the robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls shared content to gather, cache, and display information.
user_agents.scope: Content from apps or websites shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improves Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Navigates the web to enhance the relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improves advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Trains foundation AI models and improves products by indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for training AI models or indexing content directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Fetches user-requested individual links to help AI navigate websites.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules as fetches are user-requested.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services, and may train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled to improve services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services such as Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Content for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Directives in robots.txt or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches live web information to respond to user-initiated queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web information fetched on behalf of users; not for AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawler providing open web data for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset sample of the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or request addition to opt-out registry.
